The writer's text is correct; the parser is wrong. A Step-2 rewrite would be tempted to reword when_text to appease the parser, which would mask a defect affecting 16 NULL-window tasks across 14 predictions repo-wide. Fix belongs in _QUARTER_RE/_HALF_RE (admit [\s-] as the separator), not in this Need.
